name: property-based-testing
description: Writes, reviews, and debugs property-based tests — Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, jqwik, rapid, and Echidna or Medusa for Solidity invariants. Use whenever tests should cover a whole input domain instead of a hand-picked list of examples: encode/decode and serialize/deserialize pairs, parsers, canonicalizers and normalizers, validators, numeric and Decimal types, comparators and sort order, data structures, and smart-contract state invariants. Also use when adding cases to an existing @given,
author: trailofbits
summary_zh: 用于编写、审查和调试属性测试，适合覆盖完整输入域，验证序列化、解析、排序及智能合约状态等不变量。
